Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial website resource cover, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: close still life photograph of a magnifying glass over completely blank white paper and a geometric transparent glass prism, evoking careful analysis and thoughtful AI prompting.
Scene/backdrop: refined studio tabletop, white and silver surfaces.
Style/medium: professional monochrome editorial photography with natural fine film grain, real optical materials and convincing reflections.
Composition/framing: close oblique view, strong graphic arrangement of magnifying glass, paper and prism; landscape 3:2; cover-ready composition.
Lighting/mood: precise studio lighting, soft directional highlights and crisp restrained shadows, thoughtful and calm.
Color palette: white, silver, black, with one restrained electric blue accent appearing as a subtle refracted edge of the glass prism.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no UI mockups; paper is entirely blank; photograph rather than 3D rendering.
